title: Giants at the Edge
html:
Young hill giants are pushing out of the valley southeast of Underleaf. The watch pays for eight. Report to me by this board. (Sergeant Ilsa Varne, Underleaf watch)

About

Given bySergeant Ilsa Varne
Level12
LengthShort
KindSide
Quest points0

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Sergeant Ilsa Varne (outdoors near Underleaf) to get the quest.
  2. Kill 8 hill giant youths southeast of Underleaf (8)
  3. Report to Sergeant Ilsa Varne in Underleaf at -62, 206

Rewards

Reward
Gold160
Character XP6,000

What Sergeant Ilsa Varne says

Sergeant Ilsa Varne: Eight of them. Young or not, that's a lot of giant.

Sergeant Ilsa Varne: Watch pay. They'll try the edge again tomorrow, they always do.

Handing it in

"That'll turn them back for a day. The board will say when it doesn't."
